sound_effect_eq31_hint: The curve is display-only (it follows your edits, tap a dot to jump to that band). Below are 31 horizontal slider cards — swipe sideways to page through bands like a playlist. Sliders stay locked to avoid accidental touches: long-press 0.2s until it glows (with a haptic tick) to unlock, then drag left/right to change dB; it locks again the moment you let go.
sound_effect_eq31_fallback: This build has no 31-band kernel (usually 32-bit APKs), falling back to 10-band
sound_effect_pcm_hint: Sound effects use PCM processing. Your audio offload preference is restored when all effects are off.
sound_effect_failed: Could not load the impulse. Reverb is bypassed. Retry or turn reverb off.
sound_effect_preset_delete_hint: Long press a custom preset to delete it
sound_effect_head_track_hint: Renders the L/R channels as two virtual speakers at ±30° with Steam Audio HRTF and tracks head orientation with the gyroscope, so the scene stays fixed in space and turns with your head. Headphones required; with the phone off your head the tracker follows the phone, so pocket/table use will sound wrong.
sound_effect_vinyl_hint: Generated in real time by pure C++ algorithms, no samples at all: the tube is biased-tanh soft clipping (2nd harmonic 8.9dB above the 3rd), the noise is shaped white noise plus Poisson crackle, the wobble is a 6-point Lagrange fractional delay. At amount 0 the chain is bit-exact bypass.
sound_effect_vinyl_fallback: This build has no C++ flavor kernel (32-bit APK); bypassed automatically
sound_effect_surround_hint: Wide: widens the mid/high side channels plus a 0.6 ms head-shadow crossfeed (1.6 kHz low-pass) while leaving mids and bass untouched, so vocals stay intact. Immerse: adds a 2.4 ms spatial reflection for more distance. Rotate: sweeps the crossfeed and reflection delays with an LFO (0.02–0.60 Hz) so the image travels around your head. Viper: maximum widening and reflection with a tighter mono bass. Everything is linear with no feedback loops, and mono material bypasses the spatial terms entirely — no comb colouration, no hiss.
